violations.description: Unsafe GitHub Actions permissions block granting contents write access on issue_comment trigger
violations.recommendation: Restrict workflow or job permissions to the minimum necessary (e.g. permissions: read-all or contents: read) and avoid granting write permissions on pull request or comment triggers.

violations.description: Untrusted github.event.issue.title expression interpolated directly into shell script
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct interpolation in run scripts.

violations.description: Verbose curl logging prints Authorization header containing encoded secrets to the workflow run log
violations.recommendation: Remove verbose flag (-v / --verbose) from curl invocations that handle authentication tokens or secrets.
